title: Isabelle Daza fulfills promise to bring clean and potable water to a community in Rizal: ‘It’s so fulfilling’
summary: Isabelle Daza has helped bring a more reliable supply of clean drinking water to a community in Tanay, Rizal, following the installation of a solar-powered water system.
